noah: Heads-up — ran into a billing surprise on canary. client got a partial stream because router hit quota throttle, retried, and the resumed stream triggered a toolcall that was truncated. Customer saw two token lines. Anyone seen resume+toolcall truncation double-bill?
rita: can you paste request ids? quick hypothesis: provisional written on first connection, confirmed written after resume completes on fallback. If resume creates a new route/session we lose the link.
noah: xreq=cc7e, route=eu-pool-a -> fallback=eu-pool-b, resume_hint=resume-11. Logs: 
noah: ```
router: accept xreq=cc7e; quota-throttle@pool-a; stream partial; provisional_write tokens=45
router: fallback->pool-b resume_hint=resume-11
serving(pool-b): toolcall(search) truncated; confirmed_write tokens=52
```
cheng: ordering looks wrong. provisional after confirmed is possible if writes are async and reconcilers run later. We don't currently index provisional by resume_hint.
marta: console UX issue: billing page shows two items but no route context. CS asked why two charges for one user action. Devex we need a short-term explanation in UI.
devex: short-term banner: "Some sessions pending reconciliation" + a link to ticket. Longer term show route transfer reason + merged indicator.
rita: two technical paths: (A) include resume_hint/tracing_id in ledger entry and make ledger key (session, resume_hint) so recon can stitch across routes, or (B) keep current key but run a smarter recon that matches by resume_hint found in telemetry events. (A) is cleaner for real-time dedupe.
cheng: caveats: toolcalls can be non-idempotent. recon must check toolcall_idempotency flag and not collapse genuinely distinct executions. Also refunds/audit trail must preserve original writes even when we merge.
noah: ops-bot FYI kicked an incident for tracking?
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-330 created and assigned eng-platform. https://redwood.ops/incidents/INC-2026-330 :rotating_light:
rita: telemetry proposal: inference.events.v1 add optional fields [resume_hint, prev_route, transfer_reason, toolcall_id, idempotency_token]. Make them optional; routers and serving components can populate when available.
marta: plus console change: allow toggling "show route metadata" on cost breakdown for enterprise customers. That should cut CS noise.
cheng: implementation plan I like: (1) router preserves resume_hint header and emits transfer_reason (quota_throttle, capacity_fail, circuit_breaker), (2) ledger writes include resume_hint when present, (3) recon merges provisional->confirmed within TTL=45s if resume_hint matches and toolcall idempotent or tokens equal, (4) add audit log entry "merged_from" rather than delete.
noah: who wants to own RFC + canary test? I'll volunteer to run repros.
rita: I'll draft RFC and run unit tests around non-idempotent toolcalls.
devex: I'll mock banner text and tooltip for transfer_reason values.
marta: will talk to billing about showing merged invoices vs line-item collapse.
noah: thanks. follow-ups: rita RFC, cheng ledger patch, devex UI mock, marta billing sync. We'll sync tomorrow standup. :thumbsup:
